claim: The requested calibrated 96/144 comparison across all 92 routed layers cannot be run from the current artifacts without inventing or transferring calibration.
why_transfer_is_invalid: Expert functions, response means, and residual importance are layer-specific. Layer 12 also measured the existing mean-tail provider as NO-GO, so copying layer-1 calibration across depth would be both mislabeled and contradicted by a measured control.

attempted_fallback.provider: natural prefix with zero tail and arithmetic-stable full-width down reduction

minimum_substrate.description: Capture exact pre-expert inputs and routes for all 92 layers in one full-model pass over the registered calibration corpus, then reuse the existing expert-batched slab fitter independently per layer.
minimum_substrate.projection_basis: Layer-12 10K capture: 2296.964 s through 11 exact routed layers; layer-12 calibration fit: 201.723 s and 5.580 GB read. Projections are linear planning estimates, not measurements.
minimum_substrate.current_per_layer_capture_template: capture_kimi_k3_panel MODEL CORPUS CAPTURE 0 LAYER 10000 512 8 cpu
